versions.changelog: Add example requests for tarot card and spread endpoints
Update API response descriptions for card and spread endpoints

Initial release of MysticX Tarot Drawer

- Draw tarot cards individually or in 13 different spreads using the MysticX public API.
- Browse the complete 78-card Rider-Waite deck and view card meanings, keywords, and images.
- Supports localization in 9 languages; all card and spread data returned in the chosen language.
- No authentication or API key required; all endpoints are free and open.
- Easily list and learn about available spreads and card details for user questions.
- Automatic formatting guidance provided for displaying card images and details.
